task.description: Research the product line: Видеодетекция на КПП и складах — люди, машины, что в руках, вынос коробок. Market, prices, competitors, buyers, trends 2025-2026, Kazakhstan/CIS vs global. Facts with opened links and dates only.

result.summary: Checked 2026-09-29. Commodity parts are cheap: Trassir Neuro Detector 6 600 RUB/channel, Macroscop ULTRA 9 290 RUB/channel (promo), Macroscop ANPR 44 000 RUB/camera, Trassir 'Umny KPP' kits 310-670k RUB (2022), AXIS Object Analytics free in camera, Glazok.kz cloud ANPR 22 000 KZT/camera/month, ANPR cameras in KZ 279k-1.34m KZT; Verkada licence from $249/camera/year, Spot AI ~$99/camera/month (integrator data). No vendor sells 'boxes carried out / what is in hands at the gate' as a module with a public price: retail analogues only (Veesion 'a couple hundred dollars a month' per store, Everseen); warehouse offers (Insentry, CVC, NeuroCore, viAct) are quote-only or custom. DIY: Ultralytics YOLO is AGPL-3.0 or Enterprise (unpublished; forum report $5k/year); Apache-2.0 alternatives are RF-DETR Nano-Large and Qwen2.5-VL-7B; Jetson Orin Nano Super $249, Pi AI HAT+ $70/$110; Gemini Flash-Lite $0.30/1M tokens, about 100 tokens per second of video (my calculation: about $78/camera/month if run 24/7). KZ: buyers found are state tenders (Almaty 922M KZT FR rental 2026-28; 4.27B KZT for 6 000 cameras in 2023; Astana Presight 53B KZT), Samruk tender rules, trusted-software registry with 80% localisation; Almaty warehouses about 1.2M sq m; theft cases (Akbakay, Astana warehouse). Private deal sizes and KZ market size: not found. Regulation (mandatory section): personal-data law 94-V (art. 7 p.12 public-place biometrics, art. 8 consent, art. 12 p.2 KZ localisation, art. 25 breach notice), Law 256-VIII (biometrics moved to the Digital Code from Jul 2026), Digital Code 255-VIII art. 48, AI law 230-VIII art. 17 (emotion recognition without consent and biometric categorisation banned), KoAP art. 79 fines up to 200 MRP (MRP 4 325 KZT), National Video Monitoring System rules. Global market estimates diverge: Mordor $12.39B (2025) to $33.74B (2030), a Mordor resale $3.41B, Precedence $15.11B (2025); Russia video analytics 9.4B RUB (2025, Ivideon). [компания]'s own tracking/IoT products were not found publicly; [компания] at the same address is a Honeywell partner with oil and gas clients. 88 unique links in the file, 87 opened (adilet.zan.kz failed on SSL; the zakon.uchet.kz mirror was used). The art. 25 breach-notice deadline was read as 'one working day' on the first opening but not confirmed on the re-check; flagged in the file.
